title: The Devil's Star
subtitle: Jo Nesbø, 2003 · Harry Hole #5
blurb: Oslo detective Harry Hole, battling alcoholism and personal demons, investigates a series of murders in which each victim is missing a finger and has a tiny red diamond in the shape of a five-pointed star left at the scene. As the case deepens, Harry is forced to work alongside his despised colleague Tom Waaler, whose own dark secrets become increasingly entwined with the killings.

characters.name: Harry Hole
characters.description: A brilliant but self-destructive detective whose alcoholism threatens his career and relationships. He is assigned the serial murder case and grows increasingly suspicious of his partner Tom Waaler.
characters.name_evidence: Oslo Crime Squad detective, protagonist investigating the star murders

characters.name: Tom Waaler
characters.description: A charming, physically imposing colleague whom Harry distrusts. He is revealed to be the leader of the illegal weapons-smuggling network and is responsible for the murder of Harry's former partner Ellen Gjelten. He is killed by Harry at the novel's climax.
characters.name_evidence: Harry's despised Crime Squad partner, revealed as corrupt killer

characters.name: Bjarne Møller
characters.description: Harry's long-suffering boss who repeatedly defends Harry's position despite his drinking. He is a loyal institutional figure trying to hold the squad together.
characters.name_evidence: Harry's direct superior and head of the Crime Squad unit

characters.name: Beate Lønn
characters.description: A young, socially awkward technician gifted with an extraordinary ability to remember faces. She becomes a key investigative ally to Harry on the star-murder case.
characters.name_evidence: Crime Squad technician with exceptional facial-recognition ability, introduced early

characters.name: Ellen Gjelten
characters.description: Harry's close former colleague, murdered before the novel's main action. Her unsolved death motivates Harry's suspicion of Waaler and forms an emotional backbone to the narrative.
characters.name_evidence: Harry's murdered former partner, referenced throughout as victim of Waaler

characters.name: Rakel Fauke
characters.description: A woman Harry is deeply in love with. Their relationship suffers under the strain of his alcoholism and self-destructive behaviour.
characters.name_evidence: Harry's love interest and mother of Oleg, their relationship strained throughout

characters.name: Oleg Fauke
characters.description: A young boy who has formed a strong emotional bond with Harry. His wellbeing is one of Harry's key personal stakes throughout the novel.
characters.name_evidence: Rakel's young son, whom Harry has a close surrogate-father bond with

characters.name: Sverre Bjørnestad
characters.description: A high-ranking figure whose complicity in the criminal network protecting Waaler is part of the systemic corruption Harry uncovers.
characters.name_evidence: Senior police official involved in covering up corruption tied to Waaler's network

characters.name: Camilla Loen
characters.description: One of the young women murdered in the serial killing spree. Her death, marked by the signature severed finger and star-shaped diamond, opens the investigation.
characters.name_evidence: First identified murder victim found with missing finger and red diamond

characters.name: Lisbeth Barli
characters.description: Another victim in the series of killings, whose death advances the investigation and reveals further connections in the pattern of targets.
characters.name_evidence: Victim found with star diamond, connected to the serial murder pattern mid-novel

characters.name: Sven Sivertsen
characters.description: A man arrested and held as the prime suspect for the star murders. His culpability is cast into doubt as Harry pursues the real perpetrators behind the killings.
characters.name_evidence: Initially suspected serial killer arrested during the investigation
